# WJ105 · Mô hình & cấu hình

Group **WJ · Quản trị agent (Next.js)** · page · Next.js: **exists (design W2)** (`/admin/tuning`) · account `owner`

## Purpose
Model and configuration: LLM provider (kind, base URL, model, API key, test), and every tuning parameter in groups, each field autosaving.

## Agent and care context
- The API key is encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM) and never returned in full. A change applies from the next agent turn, no restart.
- Care thresholds (depth matrix, SLA) are not here: they live on the care administration pages because a doctor approves them.

## Who may see it
- Account in this frame: `owner` (a mock account of `mock/auth.ts`; the back end decides the real matrix, the menu is a convenience).
- Gate: `admin.model`.
- Roles that can open the page: owner, manager.
- Menu entry: "Mô hình & cấu hình" in the section "Quản trị agent", shown when the role holds any of `admin.model`.

## Key actions
- Search the configuration; left list of groups
- Provider form: "Lưu", "Test kết nối", "Xóa cấu hình LLM"
- Per field: edit (autosave) or "Về mặc định"; per group "Đặt lại nhóm này"; "Đặt lại toàn bộ cấu hình"

## Business rules
- Patient safety is a policy profile, never a removed feature: `patient_channel` (the default: messages to patients go to the review queue and a person sends them; memory from patient content is off; image, video, document and web tools are off; a red flag goes to a doctor before any model call; personal data is masked before the model; identity of a Zalo user is confirmed before the assistant names a patient) and `staff_assistant` (internal, staff-only accounts). The profile is set per Zalo account and per agent, the stricter of the two applies (PLAN-AI01 section 5).
